user.title: Cover Control
user.description: Shared sensors and thresholds. Every cover inherits these and can override any of them.

data.pv_threshold: PV power counts as bright above
data.pv_override_threshold: PV power outranks the weather condition above

data_description.house_orientation: The compass bearing of the side of the house you call south. 180 is a house squared to the compass; enter 195 if that side really faces south-southwest. Every window is worked out from this and the side it is on, so a house turned off the grid is corrected here once rather than window by window.
data_description.pv_override_threshold: Sustained PV power above this counts as bright even when the weather entity reports a condition that is not allowed. Set 0 to switch the override off.
data_description.wind_source_entity: Leave empty to read wind speed from the weather entity.
data_description.pv_threshold: Only used when a PV power sensor is configured.
data_description.wind_release: Must be lower than the trigger value, so gusts do not make covers oscillate.
data_description.notify_target: Notify service that gets a message on every change, for example notify.mobile_app_phone. Leave empty for no notifications.
data_description.dry_run: Evaluate and report, but never move a cover. Switched on here it overrides the per-cover setting; it cannot be cancelled per cover.
data_description.temp_hysteresis: How far a temperature has to fall back past a threshold before a running episode ends. A sensor resting exactly on a threshold crosses it on its own noise, which would end the episode and start it again a few minutes later, all day. Only applies while an episode runs, so it never lowers the threshold that starts one. 0 switches it off.
data_description.shading_step: Shading moves in steps of this size instead of following the sun by the percent, which is far fewer and larger movements. It is a share of the glass, not of the travel, so a roller shutter with light gaps steps by the same share of window as a venetian blind. Always rounded towards more cover, so the allowed sun depth is never exceeded, which costs up to one step more cover than the geometry asks for. A cover needing no shading at all still opens fully. 0 switches it off.

configure.title: Configure {cover}
configure.description: Orientation and size drive the shading geometry. The cover type is pre-selected from what the cover reports it can do.

data.name: Name
data.max_penetration_depth: Allowed sun depth into the room
data.fov_left: Field of view to the left
data.fov_right: Field of view to the right
data.shade_with_window_open: Keep shading while the window is open

data_description.facade: Which side this window is on. The bearing comes from this and the orientation of the house.
data_description.azimuth: Only for a window that is on none of the four sides, in a bay or a dormer. Leave empty to use the side of the house, which is what almost every window wants.
data_description.max_penetration_depth: 0 m means no direct sun in the room at all, which closes the cover fully whenever the sun is on the window.
data_description.fov_left: Reduce below 90 degrees only if something real blocks the sun, such as a reveal, balcony or neighbouring building. Left is the morning side for a south-facing window.
data_description.shade_with_window_open: Off leaves the cover alone while the window is open. Turn this on only for windows that are tilted rather than opened wide, since a contact cannot tell the two apart.
data_description.seating_point: Position at which the cover has fully covered the glass. Leave empty to use the cover type default. To measure it, lower the cover slowly until the light gap at the bottom disappears.
data_description.indoor_temp_entity: A sensor, or a climate entity whose current temperature is used.
data_description.dry_run: Work out what would happen without moving this cover. The decision sensor, the dashboard and the notifications all keep reporting, so you can watch it for a few sunny days before handing over control.

state.awaiting_travel: Waiting for the cover to arrive

profile_angle.name: Angle of the sun on the window

confirm.title: Covers without a controller
confirm.description:
These covers could be controlled but are not set up yet:

{covers}

To control one, add it on the Cover Control integration page: **Add cover**. Each one needs the orientation and size of its window, which is why it cannot be set up automatically.

Pick any you never want controlled and they will not be listed again. Leave the selection empty and nothing changes.
